history: Measurements were created in the desktop app in 1.6.13 build 74, then saved and retested in local 1.6.14 build 76. These files preserve the actual app output bytes. No new measurements were created in build 76.

scope: A publisher-run test of this architectural example on this local Mac build. It does not qualify the public installer, Windows, Pro workflows, every drawing, or other PDF viewers. The evaluation kit checklist remains blank for your own tests. The area label overlaps printed drawing text at the center; numeric annotations and the CSV were checked separately.
